✨ METRIOS 332 ✨
Everything you have ever wanted in an optical shop-floor measuring machine.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue

The new Metrios 332 combines ease, speed, completeness and precision in one shop-floor instrument:
  • A 300x300 measuring range combined with a unique 200 mm part passage.
  • Up to 20 kg on the stage.
  • A wide-field sensor to detect the parts on the stage and measure them at maximum speed.
  • An ultra-high magnification sensor to detect points in X-Y-Z even on the smallest details.
  • A brand new lighting system to guarantee results on even the most difficult surfaces.
